NotFound.description: Resource not found in this scope.

Document.description: A Barkpark document. `_id`/`_type`/`_rev` are always present; the remaining fields are schema-defined (see GET /v1/schemas/:dataset).

Error.description: The canonical v1 error envelope (docs/api-v1.md §9). `code` is the stable machine key; `request_id` mirrors the `x-request-id` header.

hint.description: An imperative one-line fix suggestion, when available.

bearerAuth.description: An API token minted via `bp token` / the Studio. The minimum permission tier per operation is annotated as `x-barkpark-scope`.

info.description: The Barkpark headless-CMS `/v1` REST surface, generated from the capabilities manifest served at `GET /v1/capabilities`. Auth is a bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`); the minimum required permission for each operation is annotated as `x-barkpark-scope`.
info.title: barkpark CMS API

tags.description: Bulldocs — live, no-reload paper/document surface. Ingests block-structured papers from external producers and renders them at /papers/:slug with real-time per-block streaming. Formerly the built-in Papers feature; now a first-party plugin built on the core portable-doc utilities.

tags.description: Tasks — the W7 task-document substrate as a first-party plugin. Declares the `task` schema (goals/phases/events are all just tasks) and owns the TTL-sweep + compaction Oban cron jobs. Built on the core Barkpark.Tasks machinery, which stays in core as reusable utilities.
tags.name: task
